{{Short description|Norwegian physicist (1926–2017)}}
{{Use dmy dates |date=December 2023}}
'''Anders Kristian Omholt''' (27 November 1926 &ndash; 30 April 2017) was a Norwegian physicist.

He was born in [[Aker, Norway|Aker]]. He was appointed professor at the [[University of Oslo]] from 1963 to 1971. As researcher he has contributed to the fields of [[Aurora Borealis]] and cosmic physics. He had a leading position at the [[Federation of Norwegian Industries (1919–1989)|Federation of Norwegian Industries]] from 1971 to 1977, and was director of the research council [[Norges almenvitenskapelige forskningsråd]] from 1978 to 1988.<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|title=Anders Omholt |first=Jan A |last=Holtet |encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]] |editor-last=Godal | editor-first=Anne Marit | editor-link=Anne Marit Godal |publisher=Norsk nettleksikon |location=Oslo |url=http://www.snl.no/Anders_Omholt |language=Norwegian|accessdate=1 January 2015}}</ref><ref name=hvem>{{cite encyclopedia|year=1973|title=Omholt, Anders|encyclopedia=[[Hvem er hvem?]]|editor=Steenstrup, Bjørn|publisher=Aschehoug|location=Oslo|url=https://runeberg.org/hvemerhvem/1973/0430.html|page=430|language=Norwegian|access-date=6 December 2015}}</ref> He was a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27625 |title=Gruppe 2: Fysikk, astronomi, geofysikk |publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] |language=Norwegian |accessdate=2 January 2015 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160317043752/http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27625 |archivedate=17 March 2016 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

He resided at [[Eiksmarka]].<ref name=ntb>{{cite news|title=Anders Omholt 70 år 27. november|agency=[[Norwegian News Agency]]|date=6 November 1996|language=Norwegian}}</ref> He died at the age of 90.<ref>{{cite news|title=Anders Omholt|author=Arvid Hallén|authorlink=Arvid Hallén|author2=Anne-Lise Hilmen|date=10 May 2017|work=[[Aftenposten]]|page=36|language=Norwegian}}</ref>
